# togetherai_supported_models (Data Source)

Together-hosted base models that can be deployed for dedicated inference, with their certified deployment profiles (`GET /v2/supported-models`). A profile's `model` and `config` are the values `togetherai_deployment` needs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "togetherai_supported_models" "dedicated" {
  product  = "PRODUCT_DEDICATED"
  modality = "MODALITY_TEXT"
  search   = "qwen"
}

output "profiles" {
  value = {
    for m in data.togetherai_supported_models.dedicated.models :
    m.name => [for p in m.deployment_profiles : "${p.gpu_count}x${p.gpu_type} ${p.quantization}: ${p.config}"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `adapter_mode` (String) Only models with a profile in this adapter mode: `ADAPTER_MODE_FIXED`, `ADAPTER_MODE_DYNAMIC` or `ADAPTER_MODE_DISABLED`.
- `modality` (String) Filter by input modality: `MODALITY_TEXT`, `MODALITY_IMAGE`, `MODALITY_AUDIO` or `MODALITY_VIDEO`.
- `product` (String) Filter by product: `PRODUCT_SERVERLESS`, `PRODUCT_DEDICATED` or `PRODUCT_FINE_TUNING`.
- `search` (String) Case-insensitive search across model IDs, names and descriptions.

### Read-Only

- `models` (Attributes List) Matching models. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `base_model` (String) Base model resource name.
- `capabilities` (List of String) Capabilities, such as `CAPABILITY_CHAT`.
- `context_length` (String) Maximum context length.
- `deployment_profiles` (Attributes List) Certified deployment profiles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models--deployment_profiles))
- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `id` (String) Model ID.
- `name` (String) Model name used for inference, such as `google/gemma-4-E4B-it`.
- `products` (List of String) Products the model is offered in.
- `publisher` (String) Publisher.
- `status` (String) Catalog status, such as `SUPPORTED_MODEL_STATUS_RECOMMENDED`.

<a id="nestedatt--models--deployment_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models.deployment_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `adapter_mode` (String) Adapter serving mode.
- `config` (String) Config resource name, for `togetherai_deployment.config`.
- `gpu_count` (Number) GPUs per replica.
- `gpu_type` (String) GPU type.
- `model` (String) Model resource name, for `togetherai_deployment.model`.
- `model_name` (String) Qualified model name.
- `parallelism` (String) Parallelism, such as `TP1`.
- `profile_id` (String) Profile ID.
- `quantization` (String) Quantization, such as `BF16` or `FP8`.
